headline: Arab Coalition Intercepts Houthi Drone Near Jeddah Islamic Port
summary: The Arab Coalition intercepted and destroyed an explosive drone launched by Houthi forces in the vicinity of Jeddah Islamic Port, with no reported civilian injuries.
why: Attacks near critical Red Sea shipping and port infrastructure pose security risks to international maritime trade routes and regional energy supply lines.

impacts.name: Saudi Arabia
impacts.why: Drone interceptions near key commercial ports highlight regional security tensions.
